- Original Chess.glb SHA256: 1678dd307f2d944d39786739448bca631cfdf0a13bdbb439954fb749b4a35a9a

The original unmodified GLB is bundled at public/models/chess-classic/Chess.glb.
Position Zero extracts the six named white-piece geometries at runtime, shares
them between both sides, centers/scales them and applies local ivory/ebony
materials. The included source board and drawers are not displayed. No remote
models, textures, environments or scripts are fetched at runtime.

The source page identifies this asset as CC0 and describes a size-accurate,
untextured family chessboard with individually named pieces. Credit is preserved
here voluntarily. This asset is separate from the red-and-black artwork.
